Name: Monteso's Kitchen
Author: monteso
Description:
Looking at the original kitchen layout, I could not bring myself to like it. So I made a bunch of tweaks and changes that I think others will also like aswell. Moved the sink to a spot with more room to wash and infront of a window, made it double wide, Double door frig, Cabinets rearranged and retextured for a more dark wood, the perspective of the west wall cabinets looked wonky so I removed them, added a microwave, radio (non functioning) and various clutter to give it that lived in feel. I also retextured the crib and bed to better match the dark wood theme.
[u][b]
